description: This file defines the HttpAuth class and related enums and structures for handling HTTP authentication in the Chromium project. It includes declarations for authentication schemes, targets, response handling, and challenge selection.

classes.name: HttpAuth
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods and enums for HTTP authentication handling, including challenge selection and response processing.

classes.name: HttpAuth::Identity
classes.description: Structure to track the current identity used for authorization, including source, validity, and credentials.

methods.name: GetChallengeHeaderName
methods.description: Returns the header name (WWW-Authenticate or Proxy-Authenticate) containing the auth challenge.

methods.name: GetAuthorizationHeaderName
methods.description: Returns the header name (Authorization or Proxy-Authorization) where credentials are sent.

methods.name: GetAuthTargetString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the Target enum for logging.

methods.name: SchemeToString
methods.description: Converts an authentication scheme enum to its string representation.

methods.name: StringToScheme
methods.description: Parses a string to determine the corresponding authentication scheme enum.

methods.name: AuthorizationResultToString
methods.description: Converts an AuthorizationResult enum to its string form.

methods.name: NetLogAuthorizationResultParams
methods.description: Creates a dictionary for logging authorization results.

methods.name: ChooseBestChallenge
methods.description: Selects the best supported authentication challenge from response headers.

methods.name: HandleChallengeResponse
methods.description: Processes a 401/407 response to determine next steps in authentication.
